title: A plain filter on the date key also removes filters on the other columns of the Date table

source.quote: this ALL statement is automatically applied when you apply a filter over a column of Date type that is the primary key in a relationship
source.supports: a filter on the date key removes the filters on the other columns of the Date table

source.quote: With the date column of a table marked as a date table, CALCULATE removes all the filters on the date table.
source.supports: the same rule as DAX Guide states it

derivation: The outer filter keeps Date[Year] = 2024. The inner filter is on Date[Date], the date key of the relationship, so CALCULATE also removes the filter on Year: the only visible date is 2023-01-31, with sales 20. If the Year filter stayed, no date would satisfy both and the result would be BLANK.
alternative: If the automatic ALL needs the table to be explicitly marked as a date table (the model format has no such switch), the Year filter stays and the result is BLANK.
